title: Here’s The Reason Why Children Grow Up To Become Criminals
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 15, 2022, a Racine County Sheriff’s deputy conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle after observing it speeding in Racine, WI. Upon approach, the deputy noticed four children in the backseat when the vehicle only had three seatbelts in the back. The parents appeared to be argumentative and were ultimately given several citations.

More info on the Ziminskis:
https://kenoshacountyeye.com/2022/09/14/kenosha-riot-couple-held-on-100000-each-for-kidnapping-man-at-knife-point-forcing-him-to-use-atms-throughout-city/

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
